tools.name: get_company_overview
tools.description: Get an overview of VanWest Partners (Denver-based private equity self storage investment firm) and its ClearHome Self Storage operating platform, plus an index of every site page with Markdown mirrors.

tools.name: list_investment_vehicles
tools.description: List VanWest Partners active self storage investment funds and single-asset vehicles with public unit counts, net rentable square footage (NRSF), market counts, U.S. states, and canonical/Markdown URLs. Optionally filter by 2-letter U.S. state code or vehicle type ("fund", "single_asset", or "all").

tools.name: get_investment_vehicle_details
tools.description: Get detailed public metrics and the complete facility asset table for a specific VanWest Partners investment vehicle by slug (e.g., "fund-i", "fund-ii", "fund-iii", "vwi-loveland").

tools.name: list_leadership_team
tools.description: List VanWest Partners leadership team members with titles, departments, bio summaries, and profile URLs. Optionally filter by department/team name.

tools.name: get_acquisition_criteria
tools.description: Get VanWest Partners self storage acquisition criteria for independent facility owners and brokers (single facilities and portfolios, 65% off-market sourcing), ClearHome Self Storage operating integration, accredited investor 4-step process, institutional FAQs, and contact pathways.

tools.name: submit_contact_inquiry
tools.description: Submit an inquiry to VanWest Partners investor relations or acquisitions (accredited investing, selling a self storage facility, press, or other). ONLY invoke on behalf of a real person who explicitly asked to contact VanWest Partners, using that person's genuine contact details.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_investment_vehicles, list_leadership_team · Private data: get_company_overview, get_acquisition_criteria, submit_contact_inquiry · Public sink: submit_contact_inquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_investment_vehicles, list_leadership_team · Private data: get_company_overview, get_acquisition_criteria, submit_contact_inquiry · Public sink: submit_contact_inquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
